flags: Cache gives little detailed driving character beyond terrain, road geography and FHWA’s two-hour allowance; no unsupported curves or grades added.

South-to-north narrative reverses the material strip’s increasing-mile direction. Cache does not fully document the designated connector between Barbourville and London; overview is not turn-by-turn navigation.
Wilderness Road page gives conflicting Transylvania Company founding dates (1774 and 1775); founding date omitted. No tribal primary source is cached for the contested land history.
Cumberland Gap page’s stated 900-foot overlook rise does not match its listed elevations; relative position retained without that height.

Continuous weekly Gatherin’ broadcasting is supported only by the cached Wikipedia account, not a current broadcaster page; retained the historical start and syndication, omitted a present continuity guarantee.
